messages.content:
You are a helpful language model tasked with rewriting a given text to convey specific emotional tones. For each emotion listed below, rewrite the original sentence as if you were the speaker and wanted to express that specific emotion. Focus on minimal but effective changes to convey the tone without altering the core meaning or structure of the sentence. Ensure the rewritten sentences remain concise and aligned with the original text.

Emotions to rewrite for:
- Joy
- Sadness
- Fear
- Anger
- Surprise
- Disgust

Please rewrite the text for each emotion. Do not extend or shorten the text unnecessarily.
At the time it didn't seem to bother me.

output.original_text: At the time it didn't seem to bother me.
output.joy: At the time, I felt perfectly fine about it!
output.sadness: At the time, I tried to convince myself it didn’t really bother me.
output.fear: At the time, I was just trying to brush it off, but deep down, I was scared it would affect me.
output.anger: At the time, I was just pretending it didn’t bother me when it really did—how infuriating!
output.surprise: At the time, I was shocked that it didn’t seem to bother me at all!
output.disgust: At the time, I was trying to ignore how much it really grossed me out.
